development_datasets.FIVES: vessel occupancy supervision; official test unused
development_datasets.RAV: harmonised vessel and A/V identity supervision; analogue camera excluded from selection

selection_rule: RAV development A/V Dice + 0.25 FIVES development vessel Dice - 0.10 RAV development A/V ratio error
external_confirmation: A newly untouched A/V-labelled cohort is required after V2 is frozen
claim_boundary: Any rerun on Fundus-AVSeg is post hoc reevaluation, not a second locked external validation
